_meta.description: The daemonhunter lane model (the Linux GoDFIR sweep): the journald Fields tree mapped flattened (one mapper for every structured-log key), and the long syslog/journal line kept as match_only_text in Message and Raw rather than a truncated keyword. The parent pipeline copies Message into ECS message. Shares the GoDFIR time-column conventions with the windowlicker model.
